semantics.population: same total N split into M sub-populations, each a multiple of pop_multiple=4
semantics.streams: SeedSequence(seed).spawn(1+M): child 0 = Thompson choice, children 1..M = niche streams
semantics.elites: per-niche target = ceil(elite_frac * n_i); own elites only
semantics.repulsion: closest niche-mean pair closer than the threshold re-seeds the worse niche (best/mean rel cost) from the initial distribution with a fresh stream; at most once per iteration
semantics.finalists: best screen-scored plan of each niche first, then fill by screen score (count = scaling.finalists, unchanged)
semantics.shortlist: best final-scored (K8) plan per niche among positive-saving finalists, then greedy max-min plan_distance fill, best score first; Thompson bootstrap runs on the shortlist
semantics.discovery_pure: no seeding from known cooperation families; O1-O4 remain post-hoc labels only
